title: Keyboard manager randomly stops working.
summary: Keyboard Manager reportedly stops applying remaps intermittently on PowerToys 0.101.2601.0, but the attached diagnostic archive could not be analyzed and the report lacks a deterministic trigger or the affected remap configuration.

status.label: Needs replacement diagnostics and remap details
status.detail: The public report establishes an intermittent Keyboard Manager failure, but not the specific remaps, active application, elevation state, or logs needed to identify whether the engine process, hook path, configuration load, or target app context is failing.

next_action.label: Request Keyboard Manager repro package
next_action.reason: Ask for the replacement /bugreport package plus the exact remap/export and failure conditions that would distinguish likely Keyboard Manager failure paths.

judgment.rationale: The issue is credible but currently nondeterministic: it names Keyboard Manager and a current Preview build, but does not identify which remaps stop working, whether only app-specific mappings fail, whether the engine process or hook is still running, or what changed when the behavior recovers. The automated triage comment also reports that the attached archive could not be analyzed, so a replacement diagnostic package is needed before a maintainer can select a concrete fix path.
evidence: Issue #50678 is open and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Keyboard Manager.
The report says Keyboard Manager randomly stops working on PowerToys v0.101.2601.0 installed from GitHub.
The report states that restarting PowerToys does not help and that the module sometimes starts working again, but provides no deterministic trigger.
The body links PowerToysReport_2026-09-20-17-42-35.zip, but the automated triage comment says the archive has an invalid number of entries and could not be safely analyzed.
No public thread evidence identifies the affected remap type, target application, keyboard layout, elevation state, or active Keyboard Manager process/log failure.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a fresh analyzable /bugreport archive plus exact affected remap/export and observation steps before moving this to design or implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix is not selectable yet because the public evidence does not isolate the failing Keyboard Manager path or provide analyzable diagnostics.

issue_context.summary: Intermittent Keyboard Manager remap failure on v0.101.2601.0 with an unreadable diagnostic archive and no deterministic repro details.
known_information: Symptom: Keyboard Manager randomly stops working; restarting PowerToys reportedly does not help; it sometimes resumes later.
A diagnostic ZIP link is present, but the automated triage comment says it could not be analyzed because the archive has an invalid number of entries.
No reporter comment after the triage response has supplied replacement diagnostics or more precise repro details.
inferences: The failure could involve the Keyboard Manager engine process, low-level keyboard hook, configuration reload, app-specific matching, elevation boundary, or an external input/hook conflict, but the public evidence does not distinguish between these paths.
A fresh diagnostic archive and the exact remap/export would likely identify whether the service/engine stopped, failed to reload configuration, or is bypassed only in certain foreground applications.
issue_context.analysis: This should stay in needs-information rather than design: the symptom is intermittent and broad, while the one artifact that might contain logs is currently unreadable. Asking for generic logs would duplicate the existing failed attachment; the next useful maintainer action is a focused replacement diagnostic and remap-context request.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body, labels, assignees, author, comments, and updatedAt from GitHub.
Read the automated triage comment and noted that the attached archive could not be safely analyzed.
Checked existing dashboard artifact #48003 for a similar Keyboard Manager intermittent-stop report and found it also required repro steps and diagnostics before a fix path could be selected.
Inspected the Keyboard Manager source tree layout and confirmed likely ownership spans the editor/UI configuration, KeyboardManagerEngine process, engine library, and common keyboard event handlers.
Avoided downloading or publishing diagnostic contents; the public artifact only records the need for a replacement analyzable package and remap details.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic archive that can be opened and analyzed, captured immediately after Keyboard Manager stops applying remaps.
information_gaps.why_needed: The existing linked archive could not be analyzed, and diagnostics are needed to see Keyboard Manager engine state, errors, settings load, and relevant module logs.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce the failure, then comment /bugreport immediately afterward and attach the generated ZIP.

information_gaps.information: The exact Keyboard Manager remaps that stop working, including whether they are key remaps, shortcut remaps, text remaps, app-specific remaps, or disabled keys.
information_gaps.why_needed: Different remap types use different validation, matching, and injection paths; maintainers need the affected mapping shape to choose the owning code path.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Export or describe the affected Keyboard Manager mappings, including source shortcut/key, target action, target application if any, and whether PowerToys is running elevated.

information_gaps.information: The shortest observed sequence around a failure and recovery, including foreground application, keyboard layout/input language, sleep/lock/session changes, elevation changes, and whether toggling Keyboard Manager changes the result.
information_gaps.why_needed: The issue is currently random; these details can distinguish process/hook lifetime failures from app-specific or environment-specific input handling.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with numbered steps or a timeline from the last known working state through the failure and any recovery.

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this. The issue has the right module and version, but the current diagnostic ZIP could not be analyzed, so we still need a little more targeted evidence before choosing a Keyboard Manager fix path.

Please provide:
1. A fresh PowerToys diagnostic archive captured immediately after Keyboard Manager stops applying remaps by adding a comment containing /bugreport.
2. The exact remap(s) that stop working: source key/shortcut, target action, whether it is a key remap, shortcut remap, text remap, app-specific remap, or disabled key, and whether PowerToys is running elevated.
3. A short timeline or numbered steps around one failure and recovery, including the foreground app, keyboard layout/input language, sleep/lock/session or elevation changes, and whether toggling Keyboard Manager changes the result.

Those details will let maintainers distinguish an engine/hook lifetime failure from a configuration, app-specific, or environment-specific input issue.
